allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Saturday, September 05, 2026 and  approved the following items:1. Preferential Issue of  22,25,00,000 fully convertible warrants;2.Introduction and implementation of the 'Sarveshwar Foods Limited   Employees Stock Option Scheme 2026';3. Notice of Annual General Meeting to be held on Wednesday,30th September,2026;4. Other Matters.

allot.subject: Corrigendum
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Corrigendum to Intimation regarding lapse of warrants and forfeiture of upfront payment dated 25th January, 2026.

allot.subject: Corrigendum
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Corrigendum of  Outcome dated 24th January, 2026 due to Typographical / Clerical Error in Name of Allottee approving preferential allotment of equity shares upon conversion of warrants.

allot.subject: Forfeiture
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation Regarding Lapse Of Warrants And Forfeiture Of Upfront Amount.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 37,50,000 Equity shares pursuant to conversion of warrants on Preferential basis by way of Resolution by circulation dated January 24, 2026.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 2,00,000 equity shares pursuant to conversion of warrants on Preferential basis by way of Resolution by circulation dated  January 21, 2026.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange that Right issue committee at its meeting held on August 21, 2025, has approved the letter of offer.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of rights issue Committee on August 21, 2025 intimating about approving of letter of offer for the Rights issue of the fully paid Equity shares.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: The Rights Issue Committee of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. on August 18, 2025, has, inter alia, considered and approved the Rights Issue Price, Issue Size,  Record Date, Rights Entitlement Ratio and other terms of Rights Issue.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Outcome of Board meeting held on 11-08-2025 , the following agenda has been approved . 1. The  raising of funds by way of RIGHTS ISSUE.2. unaudited standalone and consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30June, 2025 3.To consider the appointment of Mr. Anand Sharda, a Chartered Accountant by profession, as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on August 11, 2025 to approve the following agenda items:1. The raising of  funds by way of  RIGHTS ISSUE.2. unaudited standalone and consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30June, 2025 3.To consider the appointment of Mr. Anand Sharda, a Chartered Accountant by profession, as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company.
